module.Title: Create a Fixed Inventory
module.Teaching: An array stores several values of the same type. Its size is fixed after creation.
module.PredictionExplanation: Square brackets after a type indicate an array of that type.
module.DebugPrompt: The declaration needs [] because it stores multiple string values.
module.RecallPrompt: Create the Stone and Wood inventory array from memory.
module.TransferPrompt: Create an int array containing 5, 10, and 15. Use the exact identifier damageValues.
module.PreviewMessage: The preview now has a basic inventory.
